description.de: Führt alle LernApp Playwright-Tests aus. Bei Fehlern wird automatisch ein HIGH-Priority-TODO angelegt (via gate_status: RED).
description.en: Runs all LernApp Playwright tests. Creates a HIGH-priority TODO automatically on failure (via gate_status: RED).

config.label: Playwright Tests ausführen
config.command:
set -uo pipefail
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'npm not found in PATH'; echo 'gate_status: RED'; echo 'gate_category: lernapp-tests'; echo 'gate_description: npm CLI fehlt — Tests können nicht ausgeführt werden'; exit 1; }
cd '{{ project_path }}' || { echo 'project_path not accessible: {{ project_path }}'; echo 'gate_status: RED'; echo 'gate_category: lernapp-tests'; exit 1; }

echo '=== LernApp Playwright Tests ==='
date
echo ''

OUTPUT=$(npm test 2>&1)
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "$OUTPUT"

# Extract pass/fail counts from Playwright output
PASSED=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ passed' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | tail -1 || echo '?')
FAILED=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ failed' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | tail -1 || echo '0')

echo ''
echo '--- Zusammenfassung ---'
echo "Bestanden: $PASSED"
echo "Fehlgeschlagen: $FAILED"
echo "Exit-Code: $EXIT_CODE"

if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ] || [ "$FAILED" != '0' ] && [ "$FAILED" != '?' ]; then
  # Extract failed test names for the gate description
  FAIL_NAMES=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -E '^\s+[0-9]+\)' | head -5 | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | tr '\n' '; ')
  echo ''
  echo "gate_status: RED"
  echo "gate_category: lernapp-tests"
  echo "gate_description: $FAILED fehlgeschlagene Tests: $FAIL_NAMES"
else
  echo ''
  echo "gate_status: GREEN"
  echo "gate_category: lernapp-tests"
  echo "gate_description: Alle $PASSED LernApp-Tests bestanden"
fi
